component_definitions.atom_attribute_tokens: individual persistent before-to-after atom transitions, deletions and created atom-state tokens
component_definitions.atom_attributes: multiset of persistent before-to-after atom-state transitions, deletions and created atom states
component_definitions.attachment_edge_tokens: individual source-to-created attachment motifs, plus an explicit no-created-attachment token
component_definitions.attachment_pattern: address-free source-to-created target attachment graph with role type, local degree and bond order
component_definitions.bond_attribute_tokens: individual input bond transitions and target input-output or output-output bond-order tokens
component_definitions.bond_attributes: multiset of input bond-order transitions and target input-output or output-output bond orders
component_definitions.dependency_motif: address-free directed primitive dependency graph induced by created-handle and cycle open-close dependencies within the structural region
component_definitions.dependency_tokens: individual typed producer-consumer dependency motifs, plus an explicit no-dependency token
component_definitions.source_graphlets_up_to_3: connected source-region graphlets with one to three vertices and source atom and bond attributes
component_definitions.source_region_motif: address-free input-region graph with element, source degree and source bond order
component_definitions.target_graphlets_up_to_3: connected attributed induced target-patch graphlets with one to three vertices
component_definitions.target_radius_1_fragments: rooted attributed target-patch neighborhoods of radius one with boundary degree retained
component_definitions.target_radius_2_fragments: rooted attributed target-patch neighborhoods of radius two with boundary degree retained
component_definitions.target_topology: address-free target graph over surviving source roles and created roles with role type and unlabeled connectivity
component_definitions.target_topology_graphlets_up_to_3: connected target-patch graphlets with one to three vertices, input-or-output role type and topology but no atom or bond attributes

exact_equivalence.method: bucket by deterministic Weisfeiler-Lehman signature, then require exact node-and-edge-attributed graph isomorphism within each bucket

limitations: Component familiarity is exact attributed isomorphism under the frozen decomposition, not autonomous generation.
Individual component overlap does not establish that a joint conditional generator can synthesize a valid unseen patch.
The PMO artifact is answer-known training-only supervision supplied from a separate workspace path and is not merged or fitted here.
The dependency motif uses teacher execution dependencies for a training-data support audit; the sealed structural realizer itself does not consume that teacher trace.
No molecular utility, docking improvement or IVG comparison was measured.
